title: Severity response across engines
interpretation: Minimum tissue integrity vs infection severity, from one orchestrated severity×engine batch (ensemble_results.json). Both full-physics engines agree and show the severity response: near-intact at severity 0–1, collapsing to ~0.24 at severity 3.
